status: frozen-before-RT-implementation; limits are acceptance inputs, not measurements

platform.rtEligibleApi: Direct3D12 with runtime capability gates; capability is not dispatch proof

originalPathReplay.build: one development Win64 build, same GUID, two fresh processes per forced API; compare within API only
originalPathReplay.camera: ContactCamera; static base camera for all 33 renders
originalPathReplay.lighting: authored Main white directional intensity 2; Point and Spot disabled; no shadow maps or contact shadows
originalPathReplay.evidence: record actual API/GPU/supportsRayTracing, build GUID, seed, frame and pixel hashes; keep the raw linear reference for future candidate-off comparisons. B0 pre-dates the extension.

lightingBudget.tableOrder: Directional before Point before Spot, then ascending stable scene-registration key (serialized hierarchy sibling-index path + component ordinal). No camera-distance or process instance-ID tie-break.
lightingBudget.hitOrder: eligible uploaded lights by descending linear Rec.709 luminance times URP distance/spot attenuation at hit; ties by table slot. Top LmaxHit contribute; first Smax shadow-enabled contributors trace. Remaining selected lights contribute unshadowed.

hitAbi.layout: float3 radiance @0, float hitT @12, uint flags @16, uint mode @20; scalar 32-bit fields; debug IDs excluded and measured separately
hitAbi.variantScope: one metallic Lit hit pass; four independent local toggles: normal map, metallic/gloss map, emission, alpha test. Count retained distinct keyword sets; report debug separately. No specular workflow/clear-coat hit shader. Non-target count = 0.

probes.rule: fixed prefix is INCLUDED in R, not added; maintenance-only directions are excluded from irradiance/distance convolution
probes.publication: double-buffered coherent generation; preserve untouched tiles
probes.baselineG3: all three maintenance/feedback toggles OFF first; compare controls independently
probes.classification: inactive if inside by fixed backface test or no fixed front hit inside its cell (one spacing on each axis); check fixed rays on every revisit even when inactive

reflections.overflow: rotate tile start and sample slot by frame and seed; serve no more than K; unserved is unresolved (environment fallback), not sky. K=0 submits nothing.

qualityThresholds.relativeErrorDefinition: abs(candidate-reference)/max(abs(reference),0.01); evaluate linear RGB or linear Rec.709 Y as specified; no tonemap
qualityThresholds.roiDefinition: fixed receiver/target ID masks from high-sample reference; exclude one-pixel silhouette ring only for interior radiometry, never for silhouette recall. Empty ROI invalidates test.
qualityThresholds.reference: analytic geometry/direct light where available; otherwise same pose, geometry, materials, lights, seed and exposure, >=1024 samples per receiver for converged offline reference
qualityThresholds.stepFixture: diffuse 0.5 red donor, zero emission/ambient after lights out; normalize residual by pre-step steady lit minus dark reference (must exceed 0.01). Test cap separately with G1 analytic vector.

candidateWorkload.scope: normative inputs for later GI/SSR/I2; procedural fixture to be realized at those milestones, NOT the measured B0 off replay
candidateWorkload.coordinates: Unity meters; right-handed rotations not assumed; camera looks along local +Z, +Y up; all dimensions below are world-axis aligned
candidateWorkload.materials: URP metallic-workflow Lit; opaque non-emissive matte surfaces linear RGB (0.5,0.5,0.5), metallic 0, smoothness 0.2; black sky/no baked output; fixed exposure gain 1
candidateWorkload.geometry: closed 8x4x8 room centered at (0,2,0), six inward-facing quads; 2x2 mirror centered (0,2,3.98) facing -Z, metallic 1 smoothness 1; 1x1 donor at (-2,2,-2) facing +Z, diffuse (0.5,0,0), emission (2,0,0) for reflection, emission 0 for GI light-step; 0.1x2x2 opaque wall centered (2,1,0); 0.5m matte cube centered (-1,1,1)
candidateWorkload.lights: white directional intensity 1 with Euler (50,30,0); white point intensity 4 at (-2,2,0), range 6m; white spot intensity 4 at (2,3,-2) aimed at origin, range 8m, full cone 40deg. Enable all three and RT shadows for combined timing. For GI step disable all at t=0 after steady state; use no emissive donor in this case.
candidateWorkload.camera: base, perspective 60deg, near/far 0.1/50m, at (0,1.6,-2.5), pitch/roll 0; fixed 60Hz. During warmup hold yaw 0. During timed repeat t=0..119 yaw=50*sin(2*pi*t/120) degrees; identical trajectory across off/on and repeats.
candidateWorkload.dynamicObject: timed repeats translate cube on X to -1 + 0.5*sin(2*pi*t/120) each frame; capture static-build control separately with cube frozen
candidateWorkload.sourceSwitchControl: separate R3 trajectory, not timed: hold camera yaw 0; move 0.3m emissive two-sided cube center from (1,1.6,0) to (1,1.6,-2.4) linearly in 120 frames and back. Track reflected ID in mirror; donor crosses right screen edge while virtual image remains inside mirror. For shade-source A/B use the same cube with emission zero and known ambient or probe E. Reject any sequence missing both SS and HW samples in the common reflected ROI.
candidateWorkload.matrix: Forward/ForwardPlus/Deferred, RT-off, GI-only, SSR-only, both; same workload and high-tier settings within each renderer. Spotlight/point overflow and backface/cutout negative controls are separate analytic fixtures, not timed here.

performanceThresholds.scope: future I2 only, same PC/API/build settings, 1080p, single base camera; paired RT-on/off sequences; no timed readback, capture, profiler deep mode or concurrent jobs
performanceThresholds.statistic: per repeat median and nearest-rank P95; worst repeat P95 must meet each cap. Report cold start separately.
performanceThresholds.timingScope: relocate/classify separate from probe trace/update; hit shading, shadows and feedback are nested breakdowns not additive costs. Report dirty TLAS only on frames with Build; limits per stage and total must each hold.
performanceThresholds.memoryScope: peak live RT allocations including acceleration structures, scratch, both atlas generations, request lists and intermediate targets relative to matched off; missing backend counters => blocked, not 0
